== Introduction ==
Red Annihilation was held during 1997's [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/E-Sports_Entertainment_Association Electronic Entertainment Expo] (E3) and the winner of the tournament was awarded by John Carmack's turbocharged 1987 Ferrari 328 GTS. The games at Red Annihilation were played in NetQuake.
